changes: evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts) now sanitizes narrowingText with stripCodeLikeTokens before the claimsShrinkage scan: fenced code blocks, whitespace-free inline backtick spans, slash tokens carrying an explicit path marker (leading / ~/ ./ ../ prefix, URL scheme, or final segment ending in a known unambiguous file extension), and dotted tokens with an unambiguous extension plus a code-shaped stem are replaced by spaces; everything else is kept. The trigger vocabulary was revised: bare remaining is narrowed to remaining <scope-noun>, and the multi-word triggers (out of scope, not covered, remaining <noun>) accept [\s./_-]+ connectors. The proofstory-intent-hardening smoke gained 26 shrinkage-heuristic regression cases including the B-d6a0 repro where summary.changes names core/partial-done-recovery.ts. Seven verified review findings (F-001, F-002, F-003, F-005, F-006, F-007, F-008, F-009 minus the dismissed duplicate F-004) were fixed RED-first during REVIEW.
usage: No new commands. DONE summaries may now name files, paths, backticked code tokens, and URLs (for example core/partial-done-recovery.ts) without tripping unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage; genuine prose shrinkage claims (including hyphen/underscore/slash/dot-glued forms such as out-of-scope or remaining.scope) still block DONE until a confirmed scope-shrinkage decision exists. Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.js to exercise the heuristic cases.
expectedOutcome: A lightweight-path DONE summary that merely names the files it touched passes done_intent_equivalence_check with no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap, while genuine narrow-delivery prose still fails closed; the remaining-breadth decision is documented with rationale in plan.md.
actualTranscript: Pre-fix RED run: the new smoke case failed with AssertionError 'a summary naming core/partial-done-recovery.ts is not a shrinkage claim (B-d6a0 false positive)' at baseline head 2db38feff1 (bound in red-evidence.json). Post-fix at current head: proofstory-intent-hardening smoke prints 'ProofStory intent hardening smoke passed' with all 26 heuristic cases green; milestone-done-gate-reconciliation smoke OK; milestone-status tests pass; packages/main e2e ALL PASS; lattice validate --story=B-2c03 reports all configured commands pass with 9/9 verification intents covered. This summary itself names the trigger-bearing file names directly as a live demonstration.
outcomeDiff: Delivered exactly the requested outcome plus review-driven hardening of the same heuristic: the connector widening and the fail-safe extension whitelist emerged from seven verified reviewer findings against successive fix iterations. No requested behavior was dropped.
limitations: The heuristic stays deterministic and fail-safe rather than perfect: tokens such as bare extensionless hyphenated file names, dotted identifiers with non-extension tails, trigger-stemmed files with ambiguous common-word extensions, prefix-free extensionless directory paths, and scheme-less URLs can still false-positive (the gate fires and asks for a confirmed decision); authors can backtick the token or use a dotted/prefix-qualified path. Prose hidden inside a fenced code block is treated as code by convention and is the single documented false-negative direction. Two pre-existing repo-level failures are unrelated to this story: control-arm-retrieval-gate.test.mjs fails identically on unmodified main (uppercase CONTROL arm value), and the root full test suite exceeds the done_prepare 240s phase deadline on this machine (standalone lattice validate covers the same commands and passes).
pitfalls: The sanitizer runs only in the lightweight single-outcome DONE path; the strict milestone path is untouched. When editing CODE_FILE_EXTENSION_PATTERN keep it free of extensions that double as short English words (go, c, h, m, log, map, sh, zip, less, snap, lock) or trigger words gain a silent bypass (F-005 class). Any future connector or strip-rule change should add RED-first cases in proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts in BOTH directions (must-fire and must-not-fire) - every one of the seven findings came from a one-sided change.
